name: Vampire Tokyo e Iku
original_name: ヴァンパイア東京へ行く
source:
Hero is half vampire half human who goes all the way from Transylvania to Japan in order to take revenge on the girls that bullied him when he was young. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄是半吸血鬼半人类的人，为了向小时候欺负他的女孩报仇，从特兰西瓦尼亚千里迢迢来到日本。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/10/vn-of-month-december-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
